title: DataLabs · Pipeline Health
description: Is the data platform healthy? Step runs, data health checks, dbt/Elementary tests, Airflow runs, RAG quality and error logs.

list.name: pipeline
list.label: Pipeline
list.query: SELECT unnest(ARRAY['anp','rfb','rag','obs']) AS p UNION SELECT DISTINCT pipeline FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Step success rate
panels.description: success / (success + failed) over executed steps (skipped = no new data, not counted)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('success','failed')), 0) AS rate FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND pipeline IN ($pipeline)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND pipeline IN ($pipeline)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rows_out), 0) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND pipeline IN ($pipeline)

panels.title: Checks failing now
panels.description: latest result of every data health check (pipelines/observability/checks.yml)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE status IN ('fail','error')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE status = 'warn'

panels.title: ANP data age
panels.description: hours since the most recent price survey date in gold

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_value FROM obs.v_check_last_result WHERE check_name = 'anp_gold_data_freshness'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dag_run WHERE state = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(start_date)

panels.title: Last run of every step
panels.description: stale = started more than 6h ago and never finished (killed / OOM)

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline, step, health AS status, started_at, ROUND(elapsed_s::numeric, 1) AS duration_s, rows_in, rows_out, rows_rejected, files_ok, files_failed, dag_id, LEFT(error_message, 160) AS error FROM obs.v_step_last_run WHERE pipeline IN ($pipeline) ORDER BY started_at DESC

panels.title: Rows written per step run
panels.description: a sudden drop is the earliest sign of a broken source

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, pipeline || '.' || step AS metric, rows_out AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND rows_out IS NOT NULL AND status = 'success' AND pipeline IN ($pipeline) ORDER BY 1

SELECT started_at AS time, pipeline || '.' || step AS metric, duration_s AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND duration_s IS NOT NULL AND pipeline IN ($pipeline) ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '1d'), status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND pipeline IN ($pipeline) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Volume vs. baseline (median of the previous 10 runs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline, step, last_run_at, last_rows_out, ROUND(median_rows_out::numeric) AS median_rows_out, deviation_pct FROM obs.v_step_volume_baseline WHERE pipeline IN ($pipeline) ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(deviation_pct, 0)) DESC

panels.title: Data health checks — freshness · volume · reconciliation

targets.rawSql: SELECT check_name, pipeline, check_type, status, severity, observed_value, expected, message, checked_at FROM obs.v_check_last_result ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'fail' THEN 0 WHEN 'error' THEN 1 WHEN 'warn' THEN 2 WHEN 'pass' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, check_name
SELECT checked_at AS time, check_name AS metric, observed_value AS value FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE check_type = 'freshness' AND status <> 'skipped' AND $__timeFilter(checked_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(checked_at, '6h'), status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE status IN ('warn','fail','error') AND $__timeFilter(checked_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: dbt tests & Elementary anomaly detection — schema elementary

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type) status FROM elementary.elementary_test_results ORDER BY test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type, detected_at DESC) t WHERE status IN ('fail','error')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type) status FROM elementary.elementary_test_results ORDER BY test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type, detected_at DESC) t WHERE status = 'warn'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM elementary.dbt_run_results WHERE resource_type = 'model' AND status IN ('error','fail') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM elementary.elementary_test_results WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at)

panels.title: Anomaly monitors
panels.description: Elementary volume/freshness/column anomaly tests (learn the normal and flag deviations)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT test_unique_id) FROM elementary.elementary_test_results WHERE test_type = 'anomaly_detection'

SELECT table_name, column_name, COALESCE(test_short_name, test_type) AS test, test_sub_type, status, failures, detected_at, LEFT(test_results_description, 200) AS description FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type) * FROM elementary.elementary_test_results ORDER BY test_unique_id, column_name, test_sub_type, detected_at DESC) t WHERE status <> 'pass' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT name AS model, materialization, COUNT(*) AS runs, ROUND(AVG(execution_time)::numeric, 2) AS avg_s, ROUND(MAX(execution_time)::numeric, 2) AS max_s, MAX(rows_affected) AS last_rows FROM elementary.dbt_run_results WHERE resource_type = 'model' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY name, materialization ORDER BY avg_s DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(detected_at, '1d'), status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM elementary.elementary_test_results WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT end_date AS time, dag_id AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date - start_date) AS value FROM dag_run WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT dag_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'success') AS success, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed') AS failed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'running') AS running, MAX(start_date) AS last_start FROM dag_run WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY dag_id ORDER BY failed DESC, dag_id

SELECT ti.dag_id, ti.task_id, ti.run_id, ti.try_number, ti.start_date, ROUND(ti.duration::numeric, 1) AS duration_s, ti.state AS status FROM task_instance ti WHERE ti.state IN ('failed', 'up_for_retry') AND $__timeFilter(ti.start_date) ORDER BY ti.start_date DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Evaluation accuracy per run
panels.description: the evaluation task fails below RAG_MIN_ROUTING_ACC / RAG_MIN_VALUE_ACC (quality gate)

targets.rawSql: SELECT executado_em AS time, acuracia_roteamento * 100 AS "routing accuracy", acuracia_valor * 100 AS "value accuracy (vs SQL truth)" FROM ai.rag_eval_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(executado_em) ORDER BY 1
SELECT latencia_media_ms FROM ai.rag_eval_summary ORDER BY executado_em DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN plano_execucao_usa_indice THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ai.rag_eval_summary ORDER BY executado_em DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN paridade_contexto_gold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ai.rag_eval_summary ORDER BY executado_em DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tipo_consulta AS type, pergunta AS question, metodo_esperado AS expected_route, metodo_obtido AS route, acerto_roteamento AS route_ok, valor_obtido, valor_esperado, acerto_valor AS value_ok, ROUND(latencia_retrieval_ms::numeric) AS latency_ms FROM ai.rag_eval_metrics WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM ai.rag_eval_summary ORDER BY executado_em DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tipo_consulta

targets.expr: {job="airflow", event=~"alert|task_failed|step_finished|file_failed|schema_drift_.*|rag_eval_gate|check_result", level=~"ERROR|WARNING"} | regexp `- (?P<lvl>[A-Z]+) (?P<logger>[^ :{]+): (?P<msg>.*?)(?: \| \{.*\})?$` | line_format `[{{.event}}] {{ if .msg }}{{ .msg }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`
